cycle_envelopes.reason: Authentication, authorization, notifications, and extension initialization still share model and bootstrap dependencies.
cycle_envelopes.exit_plan: Introduce explicit application events and move extension/bootstrap imports out of domain modules. The envelope may shrink, but no new domain may join it.

cycle_envelopes.reason: Cross-domain integration presentation and Kubernetes runtime orchestration still connect cluster, inventory, and provider web modules. Metrics Source and Alertmanager provider packages no longer import their web/domain packages.
cycle_envelopes.exit_plan: Move remaining provider presentation and Kubernetes runtime orchestration behind canonical integration application contracts, then shrink this envelope as each reverse edge is removed.

service_form_imports.exit_plan: Replace form objects with provider-neutral command/input contracts.
Map WTForms data to user commands in the route layer.
